name: Jungle Bell Trap (CR 2)
body:
Jungle Bell Trap

CR 2

XP 600

Type magical; Perception DC 21; Disable Device DC 21

EFFECTS

Trigger location; Reset automatic

Effect spell effect (call animal)

The sound of a loud bell rings out as a character approaches, attracting the attention of a CR 1 jungle animal. The animal is not necessarily hostile, but attacks if hungry or provoked.
